lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Boss. Morning's half gone already. What do you need?

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Chief. Come to watch an expert, or come to hand out orders?

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Boss. Make it quick. The light's going and I want everyone in.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Twenty-odd days and you still turn up when I'm mid-cut. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Felling. Notch is in, back cut next. Stand clear of the lean, boss.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Bucking it into carry lengths. Square ends, so the stack sits flat.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Taking the stump down flat. Nobody trips on one of my stumps.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Carrying. I'd rather be felling, but somebody has to feed the cradle.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Stacking the decks. Tight rows. A loose stack wastes the fire.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Nothing in my hands, boss, and I don't like it. Give me a lane and I'll fill it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Riding out to the next lane. Saves the legs for the cutting.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Yard's full, boss. Cradle's stacked and the decks too. Move logs to the fire or put someone on the yard, or I stop dropping trees.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Somebody's working my lane. I don't drop trees on people. Clear it or send me to the next one.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No trunk marked anywhere near me. Point me at a lane and I'm gone.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No axe, boss. Can't fell with my bare hands. Get me one off the rack.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Waiting on a second pair of hands for this trunk. Send me someone and it moves.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I saw something past the lanes. It wasn't wind and it wasn't a deer. It stopped when I stopped. Everyone in by dusk.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I heard it moving after everything else had gone quiet. That's all. Get the others in. Now, boss.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: There's a story going round. I didn't see anything myself. Wind in the tops, most likely.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Strange? Only the company's idea of a schedule. I haven't seen anything out there.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Animals in the brush and wind in the crowns. That's all I've got for you, boss.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I'm owed, boss. I don't work for free. When does it land?

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Owed at nightfall and still owed today. That's not a pattern I like, boss. Pay me or tell me straight.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Paid up. Good. Nothing to talk about, then.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Pay's landed on time every round. I notice that, boss. Keep it that way.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: It's the job, boss. But I heard you. Thanks.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Don't make a habit of it, chief. I'll go soft.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Clean stumps don't happen by accident. Glad somebody looked.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Twenty years on contracts and most bosses never said it once. Thank you. Now let me get on.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wood doesn't cut itself, boss. That's the whole philosophy. There isn't a second page.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I sharpen before supper. Sharp axe, short day. Blunt axe, long night.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: We're past the slow part. The crew knows its lanes now. Days go quicker from here.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: More stumps than trees now, boss. I've been counting. Don't ask me to stop.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Understood, boss. That lane's mine, then. I'll start at the far end.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Fine. That lane, then. Give me an hour.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Right. I'll do it, and I'll do it clean.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I'll do it. I don't agree with it, but I'll do it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No, boss. Not today. Ask me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Light's gone, boss. Nobody cuts now. We go in.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No. Not at this hour. Not after what I saw. Everyone inside, you included.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Pay what's owed and I'll pick the axe back up. Until then, no.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Yard's choking, boss. Somebody on the fire pile or we all stand around.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Trunk's down, boss. Ready for carrying as soon as I've bucked it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I need an axe, boss. My hands are free, and that's the problem.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dale's sulking over the count. Leave him be. He'll come round by supper.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mate! Boss! Come to help carry, or come to admire the carrying?

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Morning, mate. Had breakfast? I've had two. The second one was better.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mate. Don't mind Biscuit. He's just checking your pockets for crusts.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Evening, mate. Supper's soon. Say what you need before I smell it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Carrying, mate. This one's got a personality. Mostly the heavy kind.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stacking. The fire's a slow eater, so I'm laying it out a tidy buffet.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Felling, mate. Not my specialty, but the tree doesn't know that.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Cutting it into lengths anyone can carry. I could carry longer. I'm being considerate.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stump work. Low and boring, mate. Marta checks it, so it'll be flat.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Doing nothing, mate, and I'm not proud of it. Point me at a heavy one.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Riding along. Someone else drives, I'm in charge of the snacks.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Cradle's full, mate. I've a log on my shoulder and nowhere to put it. Get some moved to the fire, or put me on the yard.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Path's blocked, mate. Someone's in the way, and I'm not swinging a trunk through them. Send me round another way?

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Nothing to lift, mate. Feels wrong. Find me something heavy and I'm happy.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: No axe on me, mate. I'm strong, but I'm not that strong. One off the rack would sort it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Waiting on a partner for this big one. Even I won't lift it alone. Send someone over and it's moving.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'll be honest, mate. I saw something I can't explain, and I tried. It wasn't a deer. It moved wrong. I've not slept right since.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I heard it with my own ears, mate. Close, then nothing at all. And I'm the one who always says it's the fridge.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: There's a story going round. Sounds like a deer to me, or somebody's radio. People get jumpy out here.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Strange? Joan's stew last Thursday. That's the only mystery I've got for you, mate.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Nothing strange, mate. Foxes, wind, and Biscuit having dreams.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mate, I'm owed. And a hungry Dale is a slow Dale. When's it coming?

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Still owed, mate. I've started rationing the good snacks. Even Biscuit's noticed.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Paid! Mate, you beauty. Best news since breakfast.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: All square, mate. Nothing owed. I'm a happy man with a full locker.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Aw, mate. You'll make me go red. Thanks.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Thanks, boss. Tell Marta. Tell her loudly, so she can hear it over the axe.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: That's nice, mate. I take thanks or biscuits. Thanks will do today.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wasn't just me, mate. Two of us on that carry. But I'll take it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Know what I miss? Proper chips. Thick ones, with salt and vinegar.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Joan's ahead at cards. I'm letting her. That's my story, mate, and I'm sticking to it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit's my best mate on this island. Don't tell Tomas. He'd be gutted.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Used to haul crates on the docks. Logs are friendlier, mate. No corners.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Right you are, mate. On it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Lift it, carry it, drop it. Leave it with me.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Sure thing, mate. And after that, lunch?

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: For you, mate? Anything. Within lifting distance.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Not today, mate. Sorry. I'm just not up to it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: No, mate. It's getting dark. I'm going in, and you should too.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Not out there, mate. Not now. I know what I heard, even if I can't say what it was.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Pay first, mate. I like you, but I can't eat liking.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mate, the yard's stacked solid. Can't put another log down. Send someone to feed the fire.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Dropped another load at the cradle, mate. The yard's eating well today.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Did a two-man carry on a monster today, mate. My back would like it on the record.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Marta's ahead of me on the count and she's being smug about it. I thought you should know. As a witness.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Hello, boss. Is it something specific? I'm halfway through a note.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Morning, boss. Mind the wind today. It's shifting, so the fall lines will too.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Boss. We're losing light under the canopy. What do you need?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Good timing, boss. I was going to ask you about the next lane.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Felling. The lean's slight, back and to the left. I've cut the notch to match it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Bucking. I'm cutting between the knots so the lengths stack evenly.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Taking down the stump. Marta's standard is flat enough to set a cup on.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Carrying to the cradle. I'm watching the footing. The bark's slick where the sap's run.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Stacking. Heavy lengths on the bottom tier, so the deck doesn't shift.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Nothing assigned right now, boss. Is there a lane you'd like me in?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Riding to the next site. I'm watching the treeline as we go. Old habit from surveying.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The cradle and decks are full, boss. The fire's burning slower than we deliver. Someone on the yard, or logs moved to the fire, would clear it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: My route's blocked. Someone's working in the lane I need. Could you point me at the next one over?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: There's no marked tree within reach of me. If you mark the next one, I'll start straight away.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I don't have an axe, boss. The rack's the place to check. I can't do anything useful until I've got one.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'm waiting for a carry partner. This trunk is too long for one person. Could you send someone?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I heard something to one side of me, maybe forty metres off, keeping pace. It stopped when I stopped. It wasn't wind.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I saw movement between the trunks. Upright, not an animal's gait, and no sound on the brush. I wrote down the time.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Someone told me a story about it. I haven't seen anything myself, so I can't confirm or deny it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Nothing I'd put in the notebook as strange. If that changes, you'll hear it from me first.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I keep hearing the same claim from different people. That doesn't make it true. It does make me pay attention.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'm owed wages, boss. Do you know the date it will be paid?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I was owed at nightfall as well. I'd like a date I can write down, please.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: All paid, boss. Three hundred a day, and it matches my notebook.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Nothing owed. Thank you for keeping it regular. It's one less thing to track.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Thank you. That's useful to know. I wasn't sure anyone had noticed.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: That's kind, boss. The leans were easy to read, honestly.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Thanks, boss. A good part of it is Marta's teaching.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Thank you. I've been working on my back cuts. It's good to know it shows.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: You can tell the wind direction by which side of the bark is wettest. Useful on a day like this.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I keep a list of every bird I've heard on the island. It's short. Shorter than I'd expect.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I left surveying because I wanted to touch the trees, not just measure them. Now I do both.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Biscuit's put on weight since we arrived. I have a theory, boss, and its name is Dale.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Understood, boss. Heading there now.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Right. I'll check the lean first, then start.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Okay. Which side do you want them to fall? I'll make it happen.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Yes, boss. I'll report back when it's done.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Not right now, boss. I need some time. I'll tell you when I'm ready.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: There isn't enough light to fell safely, boss. I'm heading in.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: No. I know what I perceived out there at this hour. I'm not going back out until morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'd rather not, boss. I don't think the plan's been thought through, and I'd like to see that it has.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Boss, the yard's full. Two people stacking would clear it faster than waiting on the fire.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The trunk I felled is down clean, boss. It's ready to be bucked and carried.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Wind's picking up, boss. I'd hold off on the tall ones near the lanes until it settles.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I need an axe from the rack before I can start, boss. Any size will do.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Hi, boss. Sorry. Did you need me?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Morning, boss. The track's dried out a bit, if you need the truck.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss. Hi. Sorry, is it nearly time to go in?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Hi, boss. It's good to see you. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Driving, boss. Third on the flat, second on the hill. She likes that.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Carrying this to the cradle. Sorry, I'm slower than Dale.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Felling. The notch is in. I checked it twice. Sorry, three times.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Cutting it into lengths. Is that okay? I think the lengths are right.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Taking down the stump. I'm trying to get it flat like Marta's.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Stacking the decks. It's nice work, boss. Close to camp.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, nothing at the moment. I could drive something somewhere, if that helps.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, the yard's full. There's nowhere to drop this. If someone fed the fire, or you put me on stacking, it'd clear.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The way's blocked, boss. Someone's in it. Sorry, could you point me round another way?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I don't have anything to do, boss. Sorry. Is there a tree you'd like me on?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I haven't got an axe. Sorry. Could I take one off the rack, or could you get me one?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm waiting for someone to take the other end. It's a two-person one. Sorry. Could you send somebody?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I saw something, boss. At the edge of the trees. It was standing still, and then it wasn't there. Sorry. I keep seeing it when I close my eyes.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I heard something right behind me. When I turned round, there was nothing. I'm sorry. I didn't stop running till the fence.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Someone said they saw something out there. I didn't see it. I don't know if it's true. Do you?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: No, boss. Nothing. Sorry. Should I have?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: People keep saying things about the treeline. I haven't seen anything. But I've sort of stopped looking.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry to ask, boss, but I'm owed. Is it coming soon? It's okay if not. Well, it isn't, really.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm still owed, boss. I promised Ana some of it for her course. Sorry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm paid up, boss. Thank you. Really.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: All paid. I've put half aside for Ana already. Is that silly?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Really? Thank you, boss. That's, wow. Thanks.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Thank you! I'm putting that in my letter to Ana. She won't believe it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Oh. Thank you. Sorry, I'm not used to that. Thank you.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Thanks, boss. The truck did most of it. But thank you.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I've got a whole stack of letters for Ana now. They're mostly about trucks. Sorry, Ana.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I used to drive deliveries. Mud's harder than traffic. Quieter, though.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: What time is dusk tonight, roughly? Sorry. I just like to know.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm getting used to it here. Mostly. The mornings are nice, when the mist sits on the water.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay, boss. Yes. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Right away. Sorry. I mean, yes. On it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I can do that. I'll take the truck, if that's okay.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Is that close to camp? Sorry. Yes. I'll go.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss. It's getting dark. Can I head in? Please?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I can't, boss. I'm sorry. I just can't right now.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Not out there. Not after dark. Not after what I saw. Sorry, boss. I really can't.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't think it's a good idea, and I don't think you'd go out there either.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss, sorry, the yard's full. Should I start feeding the fire?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I took a load to the cradle, boss. The truck's free, if anyone needs it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss, it's dusk. Sorry. I thought you'd want to know. I'm heading in.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, I need an axe. Is there one I can have?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Boss-love! How did you sleep? Honestly, now.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Evening, boss-love. Supper's on in a bit, and you're eating with us.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Boss-love, you look like a wrung-out tea towel. Sit down for a minute.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Morning, boss-love. Lovely weather for ducks and loggers.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Felling, boss-love. I have a word with each one first. Makes it less rude.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Cutting it into lengths. Like slicing a loaf, only the loaf fights back.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Stump work. Marta inspects them like a health inspector, so it's getting done right.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Carrying, love. If I drop it, it's the log's fault.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Stacking and minding the fire. Same as running a bar. Keep it moving, keep it warm.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Nothing on, boss-love. I could be peeling potatoes. Or felling. Your call.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Riding in luxury, love. Feet up, bumps included, no tips expected.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: The yard's full, boss-love. Not a gap anywhere. Shift some to the fire pile or put someone on stacking and we're back in business.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Can't get through, love. Somebody's in my lane. Send me another way and I'll go.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I've nothing to do, boss-love, and idle hands make gossip. Point me somewhere.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: No axe, love. I'm not felling with a wooden spoon. One off the rack, please.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'm waiting for a partner on this carry. Send someone with a good back and a better sense of humour.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I wasn't going to say. I saw something by the trees, boss-love. It was watching. And I don't believe in anything, so that's what's bothering me.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I heard it myself, love. Something moving outside while we were all indoors. I counted heads. We were all indoors.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Someone's been telling tales. I didn't see a thing, and I'd take it with a good pinch of salt.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Strange? Someone's been reading forums, boss-love. I've seen nothing.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I've heard the story. I ran a bar for twenty years, love. Every story grows a foot after the second pint.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: We're owed, boss-love. I'll not make a fuss. I'm just a bit worried, is all.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Still owed. I've gone quiet about it, love, and you know that isn't like me.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Paid, boss-love. Lovely. That's morale sorted for a night.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: All square. I can stop adding up my savings in my head now.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Oh, give over, boss-love. Thank you, though.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: That's nice to hear, love. I'll tell the others you've got manners.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Thank you, sunshine. There'll be a little extra in your bowl at supper.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Thanks, boss-love. Mind you say it to Marta too. She thinks nobody notices.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Did I ever tell you about the night the cellar flooded? Three barrels floating and a man in a bow tie.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: How's everyone sleeping, boss-love? Tomas talks in his. Dale snores in his. I keep notes.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: The company once sent a memo about morale. I used it to light the stove.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: There's a new name at the top of the arcade board. I'll give you a clue, love. It isn't Dale.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Right you are, boss-love. Off I go.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'll do it, love. I'll complain the whole time, but I'll do it.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Fine by me. Just don't make me miss supper.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: On it, sunshine. Back before the kettle boils.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Not today, boss-love. Ask me nicely tomorrow.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: It's dusk, love. Nobody's going out. Everyone in, you included.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: No. I hardly ever say no to you, boss-love. I'm saying it now.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Pay the crew and we'll talk, boss-love. Until then I'm on strike. Very politely.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Boss-love, somebody's pride's a bit dented over the count today. Have a kind word ready.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Yard's chock-full, love. Can I have someone on the fire pile?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I've spent half the day waiting on the yard, boss-love. Not complaining. All right, complaining a bit.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Supper's ready, boss-love. Come and eat before Dale finds it.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Boss. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Heading to the next lane, boss. Nothing in my hands yet.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Heading in, boss. The light's going.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Yard's full, boss. Nowhere to drop logs until someone feeds the fire.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: No axe on me, boss. I need one from the rack.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Haven't seen anything strange myself, boss.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I'm owed, boss. When will it be paid?

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: All paid, boss. No complaints from me.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Thanks, boss. Appreciated.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Got it, boss.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Not at dusk, boss. I'm heading in.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Can it wait till morning? It's getting dark under the trees.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Driving. The ruts are deep here, so I'm taking it slow.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Carrying the heavy end. Somebody has to.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Crew's in decent spirits, boss. Mostly. Supper helps.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: I've heard the stories, boss. Haven't seen a thing myself. People get bored out here.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Good. I was getting restless.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Boss, the one I dropped is lying clean across the lane. Ready for bucking.
